PreviewCardRoot.description: Holds the card's open state and shares it with the link and the card. Renders no element, so it can wrap the paragraph the link is in.

props.open: Whether the card is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it.
props.defaultOpen: Whether the card is open at first, when it isn't controlled.
props.onOpenChange: Called with the new state when hover, focus, Escape or a press outside opens or closes the card. It is called in a change of its own, after the card's: a request it starts (a preview that loads on open), or a handler that is itself an action, doesn't hold the card.

PreviewCardTrigger.description: The link the card previews. It opens the card on hover and on keyboard focus, after the delay.

props.delay: How long the pointer rests on the link, or focus stays on it, before the card opens, in milliseconds.
props.closeDelay: How long after the pointer leaves the link and the card before the card closes, in milliseconds.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the card is open.

PreviewCardPopup.description: The card: an element with `popover="manual"`, placed against the link with CSS anchor positioning. It takes no role. Style it with `:popover-open` and `@starting-style`.

props.side: Which side of the link the card sits on. The browser flips it when it doesn't fit.
props.align: Which edge of the link the card lines up with, along the side.
props.sideOffset: The gap between the link and the card, in pixels.
props.alignOffset: How far the card is moved along the link's edge from its `align` position, in pixels.

dataAttributes.data-side: Which side of the link the card is on: the `side` asked for, then the side the browser placed it on once open.

PreviewCardArrow.description: An element placed on the card's edge that faces the link, centred on the link. It follows the card when the browser flips it. Give it a shape in CSS and turn it per `data-side`.

dataAttributes.data-side: Which side of the link the card is on. Absent until the card first opens; a close keeps the last side.
